findings.issue: The supplied assertions do not cover two explicit A3 acceptance cases: a three-slot request charging only the per-artist price, and provider success followed by local persistence failure. The fixture always creates one-slot requests; the lost-response test throws from the mocked provider request.
findings.repro: Inspect fixture.offer(), which sets artistSlots to 1, and provider.drop(), which throws before returning the provider response. Neither exercises the required scenarios.

checks.provider_configuration: Visible code requires test mode and a development-key prefix, and rejects charge responses without devMode=true. Actual provider contract compatibility was not verified.
checks.secrets_and_projections: Visible code hashes an allowlisted, checksum-valid CPF with HMAC and omits CPF from the provider creation payload. Full projection review was limited by truncated output.
checks.transactional_safety: Not fully assessed: the returned source output omitted central payment mutation and action code.
checks.route_and_ui: Visible webhook route forwards the body and verification material to the internal action. Payment components show demo labels, copy feedback and verification controls. Integration into existing offer cards was not established.
checks.assertions: Reviewed the visible synthetic tests statically; identified the acceptance-coverage gap above.

limitations: One batched read of spec.md and source.txt was performed. Tool output was truncated; files were not reread.
